journey.title: Tab out of the visit date into the access notes
journey.goal: Pressing Tab in the open date field moves focus to the next form field so the user can keep typing

functionalJourney.title: Pick a visit date with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Clicking a day in the calendar fills the visit date field

guards.title: Pick the next day with arrow keys
guards.goal: Arrow keys move the calendar focus and Enter commits the date

plan.root_cause: The datepicker widget traps focus when open, preventing the Tab key from moving focus to the next form field. The datepicker's keydown handler does not allow the Tab key to escape the widget when the input field is focused.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the datepicker's keydown handler to hide the datepicker when the Tab key is pressed and the datepicker is active, allowing the browser to move focus to the next focusable element. For other keys, delegate to the original keydown handler.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Tab when the datepicker is open and the input field is focused will hide the datepicker and move focus to the next form field (the access notes input), allowing keyboard users to continue navigating the form.
functional_risks: Hiding the datepicker on Tab may interfere with users who wish to navigate within the datepicker using Tab (e.g., to move between buttons inside the datepicker). However, the datepicker's internal buttons are not visible in the observed state, so this risk is low.

If the original onKeydown handler prevented the default action of Tab for some reason, overriding it with this change might cause unexpected behavior. However, the observed failure indicates that Tab is not moving focus, so the current handler is already preventing the expected behavior.
verification_requirements: Tab key pressed while visit-date input is focused and datepicker is open should move focus to the notes input.
Shift+Tab key pressed while visit-date input is focused and datepicker is open should move focus to the contact input (if applicable).
Other datepicker keyboard navigation (e.g., Arrow keys to change date, Enter to select) should continue to work as expected.
Datepicker should still open when the visit-date input receives focus via mouse or keyboard.
Datepicker should close when clicking outside or pressing Escape as before.

plan.root_cause: The datepicker's keydown handler (onKeydown) traps focus when the widget is open, preventing the Tab key from moving focus to the next form field. The event listener is registered as `onKeydown.bind(null, this)` which handles all keydown events but does not allow Tab to escape the widget.
plan.repair_strategy: Replace the keydown listener registration with an inline arrow function that checks for the Tab key when the datepicker is active. If Tab is pressed, hide the datepicker and return without calling the original handler, allowing the browser's default focus navigation to proceed. For all other keys, delegate to the original onKeydown handler.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Tab while the visit date input is focused and the datepicker is open will now hide the datepicker and move focus to the next form field (Access notes), satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: If the original onKeydown handler relied on preventDefault for Tab (unlikely), this change could alter behavior. However, the observed failure shows Tab is not moving focus at all, so the current handler already blocks default behavior.
Shift+Tab (reverse tab) is not explicitly handled; it will fall through to onKeydown which may or may not handle it. This is acceptable as the primary goal is forward Tab navigation.
verification_requirements: Tab key pressed while visit-date input is focused and datepicker is open moves focus to the notes input.
Datepicker closes when Tab is pressed while open.
Arrow keys (Left/Right/Up/Down) still navigate within the datepicker when open.
Enter key still selects a date when a day cell is focused.
Escape key still closes the datepicker.
Clicking outside the datepicker still closes it.
Datepicker opens when visit-date input receives focus via mouse or keyboard.
Form submission works with the selected date.
